entities.summary: Julian Dunajewski (b. 1822-07-04, Ivano-Frankivsk) was a military leader or commander of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Ivano-Frankivsk. Known in the fields of merchants & economists.
